umask 077
cd /home/admin1/projects/ai-core

import pathlib,subprocess,json,os,sys
root=pathlib.Path('.ai-core')
v=root/'distillation-venv'
py=str(v/'bin/python')
assert v.is_dir() and not v.is_symlink()

body='## Isolated CPU PyTorch installation attempt\n\n```json\n'+json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n```\n\nOfficial CPU wheel index; no GPU billing or global package change. Import and optimizer checks remain separate.'
subprocess.run(['gh','issue','comment','1','--repo','seigo-gace/ai-core','--body-file','-'],input=body,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=5)
